method: single-step max-T (Westfall-Young), studentised, one shared critical value per (slice, metric) family

contrasts.name: C1_replay_vs_none
contrasts.claim: Replaying history helps before any curation is applied

contrasts.name: C2_curation_vs_random
contrasts.claim: Curating the buffer adds over drawing from it at random

contrasts.name: C3_non_error_vs_error
contrasts.claim: Error-driven selection underperforms other curation (noise amplification)

contrasts.name: C4_blend_vs_single
contrasts.claim: Blending criteria beats committing to one

contrasts.name: C5_error_driven_vs_none
contrasts.claim: Error-driven replay is better than not replaying at all

group_score: unweighted mean of member arms within each resample
